summary: Healthcare Realty Trust Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its subsidiary's issuance of $700 million (plus $100 million greenshoe) 3.00% exchangeable senior notes due 2032 under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust. The notes are senior unsecured obligations of the issuer and guaranteed by the parent. Interest is payable semi-annually; maturity is 2032. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No terms like a buyback, tender, or strategic event are present.
